raw_report_bytes: Task report/evidence originals are untouched. Every archive entry is checked by SHA256. Selected raw evidence blobs must equal working bytes.
product_line_endings: Existing Git LF attributes apply to product text; raw working bytes remain in archive and source hashes. Corpus blobs must preserve raw bytes exactly.
local_only: Unselected task evidence paths are preserved inside archive but remain local at their original paths. Stage/commit receipts and session logs are local and may be removed by later cleanup. Archive is not an instruction to restore deleted files.
scope: No timing cache, unrelated operator/product edits, engine files, old scratch or other memories are staged.
administrative_closeout: administrative-closeout.md records the unchanged corpus CRLF/JSON indentation audit and the resumed exact commit.
